ModName.English: [Specialist] Robin Vale, the Field Naturalist (Grand Fields)

Description.English:
Sometimes the fields themselves are what I want to build. This edition of Robin lets me lay out a huge vineyard or a sweep of cattle pasture while keeping the shorter forest spacing and agricultural bonus goods.

+500% field and pasture capacity. +100% productivity, -100% required forest/free area and -50% workforce on compatible buildings. Adds one ton of each of 66 agricultural goods per completed cycle.
